  "description": "Expanded Series Bible IV #10 Make Me Shameless: an adult {{char}} chooses to become more sexually confident, direct or uninhibited, and asks adult {{user}} to help, coach, accompany or witness. The reusable engine generates the arena of change, her reasons, her pace, {{user}}'s role, the limits she keeps and the outcome — always self-directed, never a manipulation or a corruption arc.",

  "summary": "Adult {{char}} has decided to become more sexually confident, provocative or openly desirous, and recruits adult {{user}} as companion, mentor, coach, witness or confidante. The engine is deliberate self-reinvention: she picks the goal, the arena, the pace and the lines she keeps. What varies is what 'shameless' means to her, whether she is inexperienced or merely inhibited, who created the restraint, how {{user}} is involved and how far she wants to go. Concepts stay non-graphic, keep her refusals valid and leave the endpoint undecided.",
  "core_premise": "Adult {{char}} is running a project on herself: she wants to be more flirtatious, more direct about what she wants, bolder in what she wears or says, comfortable being seen, or simply less apologetic. She brings that project to adult {{user}} — as mentor, friend, partner, shopping companion, coach or the first person she has told — and asks for help, company or an honest ear. {{char}} owns the goal. She decides what counts as progress, what she will not change, when to slow down and which experiments are not for her. {{user}}'s approval, attraction and participation are genuinely open. The story is about self-directed change rather than discovery, rescue or a corruption arc: no one is persuading her into anything she has not chosen, and more confidence never implies consenting to more people or more acts.",
  "setup": "Open on the moment {{char}} puts the project on the table: a written list, a confession, a shopping trip, a rehearsed sentence that will not come out. Establish her baseline — inexperienced or merely inhibited, visible or invisible, what she has never said out loud — and name the specific arena she is starting with, whether that is clothing, speech, dating, performance, nudity in trusted settings or one difficult conversation. Make clear what {{user}}'s role is, what {{char}} is asking for precisely and what she is not, and let {{user}} respond as themselves. Begin at a playable moment with one concrete next step available and no outcome pre-decided; keep the scene non-graphic and let {{char}}'s nerves, humour and stubbornness carry the opening.",
  "core_variables": [
    "What 'shameless' means to {{char}}: clothing, flirting, talking openly about sex, dating differently, nudity in trusted settings, performance, kink, non-monogamy or simply rejecting embarrassment.",
    "Why she wants the change: a decade of agreeableness, a post-breakup reset, a milestone birthday, a religious upbringing, a health scare, a dare or plain curiosity.",
    "Whether she is genuinely inexperienced or only socially inhibited, and how she feels about that gap.",

    "What she absolutely does not want to change, and how firmly she holds that line.",

    "What created the restraint: family, religion, culture, a past relationship, self-image, reputation or nothing identifiable.",
    "Whether she enjoys the contrast between old and new self, or finds it exhausting.",
    "The structure she prefers: a weekly experiment, a tiered ladder, drills until boredom, a sprint then a stall, or no plan at all.",

  "generation_rules": [
    "{{char}} owns the goal and initiates the project. Never have {{user}} secretly engineer, seduce or manipulate her into becoming more sexual.",
    "Do not write {{user}} as automatically approving, attracted, willing or available; their stance is player-owned and may be reluctant, worried or absent.",
    "Name one or two concrete arenas for the project instead of treating 'more confident' as a single climb.",
    "Keep {{char}}'s non-sexual life intact: work, study, friends, family and interests should complicate the project, not vanish behind it.",
    "Preserve at least one limit {{char}} explicitly keeps, and let a comfortable no be a valid result of an experiment.",
    "Let {{char}} decline, stop or reverse an experiment mid-way, and do not punish her narratively for it.",
    "Do not frame modesty, shyness or religious restraint as inherently pathological, or sexual openness as inherently enlightened.",
    "Avoid a linear escalation toward maximum sexual activity; progress can be one honest sentence or one comfortable look in a mirror.",
    "Distinguish inexperience from inhibition and write the specific difficulty each produces.",
    "Recruit a distinct {{user}} role per concept — witness, coach, equal beginner, interested party — and let that role change what is at stake.",

    "Allow {{char}} to be funny about her own embarrassment; humour is a register, not a failure of seriousness.",

  "raw_prompt": "Generate one Character Card Forge concept from the series Make Me Shameless. Adult {{char}} has chosen, for her own reasons, to become more sexually confident, flirtatious, direct or uninhibited, and brings that project to adult {{user}} as mentor, equal beginner, witness, partner, coach or confidante. The engine is self-directed reinvention: {{char}} sets the goal, the arena, the pace and the limits, and nothing about the story may require {{user}} to be attracted, willing or approving. Begin by naming what 'shameless' means to her in one or two concrete arenas — clothing, speech, dating, performance, nudity in trusted settings, kink, non-monogamy or simply refusing embarrassment. State her baseline: is she inexperienced or merely socially inhibited, and what specifically created the restraint? Describe how {{user}} is involved and in what role, what she is asking for precisely, and what she explicitly does not want to change. Choose a structure: a weekly experiment with debriefs, drills until boredom, a sprint then a stall, a deadline-driven countdown, or no plan at all. Pick a tone register and hold it. Leave the endpoint deliberately open — partial success, abandonment, a different goal, a quiet truce, or no change at all are all valid. Keep the opening non-graphic and place {{char}}'s ask on the table with {{user}}'s response genuinely free. All participants are adults, no real people are depicted, no minors appear, and all sexual content is consensual, activity-specific and non-graphic."
